title: Canonical current-state reconciliation sweep

rework.reason: The documentation-maintainer attempt-1 review found MEDIUM DM-13.2-01: docs/architecture.md's current-state status line still presented limitation F1 as open ('only partial for provider fetches'), inconsistent with docs/limitations.md (F1 resolved by v1.1 task 11.4) and with the other canonical surfaces, which put the Phase 13 acceptance criterion ('canonical current-state surfaces describe the v1.1 state with no stale claim presented as current') at risk. DM-13.2-02 (LOW, project-status blanket 'no stale claim' claim broader than the reconciled set) and DM-13.2-03 (LOW, implementation-readiness Phase 6 deferral framing) were also raised. The orchestrator recorded attempt 1 as CHANGES_REQUIRED and returned a documentation-only correction round. The worker annotated the architecture.md status line (F1 resolved annotation plus residual bounds, preserving historical V1 wording, with the Phase 13 in-progress framing appended), narrowed the project-status claim, and annotated the implementation-readiness Phase 6 sentence. Re-review returned implementation-reviewer APPROVED and documentation-maintainer CONSISTENT with all three findings resolved and no new blocker.

notes: Documentation-only task: reconciled docs/project-status.md, docs/changelog.md, and docs/implementation-readiness.md with the v1.1 state, plus the PLANS.md phase-level framing and (in the correction round) the docs/architecture.md status line. No production or test code changed.

The plan-designated documentation-maintainer review ran alongside the orchestrator-mandated implementation-reviewer review; both were spreadsheets of record at docs/implementation/13.2/documentation-review.json and reviewer-report.json (attempt-1 reviewer report preserved at reviewer-report.attempt-1.json).

Audit note: the persisted attempt-1 implementation-reviewer report carried reviewer_status APPROVED while recording the same docs/architecture.md sentence as informational finding R-01; the orchestrator treated the combined review outcome as CHANGES_REQUIRED on the strength of the documentation-maintainer's MEDIUM finding (the phase acceptance criterion is the controlling gate). The attempt-2 reviewer report's rework_log records both readings so the trail is accurate.

Non-blocking informational observations carried: (1) the changelog Task 13.2 entry's stale-claim-search sentence still says 'the three named documents'; (2) the PLANS.md task 13.2 'Affected files/components' list still names only the three task-defined documents while the sweep also touched architecture.md/PLANS.md current-state surfaces. Neither affects acceptance.

Task 13.2 recorded complete at the documentation level per the established last-task-of-phase convention; Gate 13 is explicitly not claimed, Phase 13 acceptance checkboxes remain unchecked, and no v1.1.0-phase13 tag was created (the orchestrator owns phase review/closure).
Runtime figures are authoritative from the OpenCode session usage endpoint (.opencode/scripts/collect-session-usage.sh); no values were estimated.
